profile_text.body:
Toyota Research Institute is a for-profit research organization founded in 2015 and headquartered in Los Altos, California. It operates the website tri.global. On its own site, the institute says it envisions a future where Toyota products, enabled by TRI technology, dramatically improve quality of life for individuals and society. It also describes its working environment as a start-up setting with financial backing behind its goals.

The site text does not name specific AI products or research programs, and the record lists no products for the company. Its stated position is tied to Toyota products, with TRI technology described as the means by which those products would improve quality of life.

The record shows legal exposure in California, with a count of 270. No individual cases are listed, and no MCP servers are recorded.
